invested_rule: REGIME sets the base: ≥ +0.5 → 90% · ≥ +0.2 → 75% · middle → 60% · ≤ −0.2 → 40% · ≤ −0.5 → 25%; STRETCH moves it by up to 20 points (−20 × stretch); credit not confirming takes 10 off; bounded 15–100. These bases and swings are a proposal for Alan, not settled numbers.
regime_rule: 0.6 × structure + 0.4 × breadth. Structure per index (SPY, QQQ, averaged): above the latest confirmed 2W P1 and holding (> 1.5% over it) +1 · retesting it from above (−1% to +1.5%) +0.6 · uptrend under resistance (over the 200-day, under the line) +0.2 · lost a broken line −0.5 · under the line and under the 200-day −1. Breadth: the served companies' % above the 200-day and % above the 50-day, each (pct − 50) ÷ 25, averaged, clamped. Credit is a condition, not a vote: HYG's Geiger at or under −0.5 names it and takes 10 points off.

pivotRule.note: ta.pivothigh(high, 2, 2) on the provider's 2W bars; a break = the first daily close above the pivot high after the bar that confirms it
